finalAttackQuestions: Can all positive cases be represented as generic authoritative state/transition without a named Game case-determination responsibility?
Can determination target/status be deleted without losing the identity of what is officially being decided?
Can binding authority/currentness be inferred from role labels, correctness, causal power or rule authority without an explicit F5/F6 binding relation?
Can all determination bases be merged into one untyped relation without losing evidence-vs-norm counterfactuals?
Can review/reversal/history force a non-derived lineage primitive?
Can enforcement/remedy force a fourth core obligation?
Can solitary/self-authored play produce case determination without importing external institutional authority?
Can one Human/Agent/model simultaneously hold proposal, interpretation, rule-change, case-determination and enforcement powers without collapsing operation-specific authority?
Can the boundary distinguish deterministic execution from deterministic official determination?
Is the surviving responsibility actually generic legal/social/epistemic infrastructure rather than Game-owned?

totalCompressionAttack.nullModel: No GDF3 responsibility; use only F1-F9 + GDF0 EffectiveRuleTopology + GDF1 GameActionContract + ordinary scoped authority relations.
totalCompressionAttack.whyRepresentationPasses: Every instance can be encoded using State/Relation/Transition/Time/Authority/Observation/Evaluation/Action semantics; no F10 is required.
whyResponsibilityFails: generic authoritative state does not itself require distinguishing the target/status relation from underlying World state or event history
generic role/authority facts do not themselves require distinguishing binding case authority from recommendation, rule-change, appointment or enforcement authority
generic provenance links do not themselves require preserving case/evidence basis versus norm/evaluation/application basis when those can vary independently
without a Game-owned case-status contract, multiple GameForms can remain technically representable while repeatedly collapsing the same domain distinction
totalCompressionAttack.analogy: GDF1 GameActionContract is likewise a responsibility contract over F1-F9 rather than a new primitive.

obligationAttacks.falsifier: The same status token or authoritative state label can apply to action legality, run category, record certification, judged score, sanction, appeal admissibility or match result; without an explicit target/status relation the determination identity is under-specified even though all terms remain representable in F1-F9.

obligationAttacks.attack: infer binding force from role label, causal power, rule authority, correctness or model identity
obligationAttacks.falsifier: Identical case content can be advisory or binding; the same entity can have rule-change authority but not case authority, or case authority but not enforcement authority; a solitary player can be current practice authority without any external institution. Binding status therefore requires a scoped/current authority relation, not an identity heuristic.

obligationAttacks.attack: merge every basis relation into an untyped bag
obligationAttacks.falsifier: Holding evidence/history fixed while current norm/interpretation changes can reverse the determination, and holding the norm fixed while evidence/history changes can also reverse it. When those counterfactuals matter, basis provenance must distinguish the two relation families.

boundaryDefinition.name: CaseDeterminationBoundary
boundaryDefinition.frozenRule: Use the AuthoritativeCaseDeterminationContract only when a Game/PlayPractice exposes an independently meaningful current binding case status: a status whose target/content, binding authority/currentness, or materially relevant basis can vary independently from the underlying event/history/direct execution semantics. Direct deterministic execution or admission need not instantiate the contract when no such independent case-status semantics exist.

frozenContract.name: AuthoritativeCaseDeterminationContract
frozenContract.statement: When a Game/PlayPractice exposes an independently meaningful current binding case status, preserve enough structure to identify (1) the determination target and current status/result; (2) the F5/F6 authority, scope, currentness and provenance that make it binding rather than advisory/classificatory/proposed; and (3) when materially counterfactual, typed determination-basis relations sufficient to distinguish case/evidence/canonical-state basis from norm/evaluation/application basis. Do not require a separate Case, EvidenceSet, Interpretation, Review, Precedent, Discretion, Judge, Agent, or Enforcement object.

frozenAntiCollapseLaws: Participant is scope-qualified, not a universal primitive
Authority != GlobalRank and AuthorityTopology != Tree by necessity
ExternalInstitution != necessary condition for binding PlayPractice authority

foundationReopenConditions.name: Determination identity failure
foundationReopenConditions.trigger: At least two materially different GameForms expose an independently meaningful binding case status whose target/status identity cannot be represented through existing F1-F9 relations plus the frozen contract without adding a new semantic distinction.

foundationReopenConditions.name: Binding authority failure
foundationReopenConditions.trigger: Repeated cases cannot distinguish advisory/classificatory output from current binding case status using existing F5/F6 scope/currentness/provenance and operation-specific authority relations.

foundationReopenConditions.name: Determination-basis failure
foundationReopenConditions.trigger: At least two materially different GameForms require a recurring determination-basis distinction beyond typed case/evidence/canonical-state versus norm/evaluation/application provenance, and the missing distinction changes Game counterfactuals.

foundationReopenConditions.name: CaseDeterminationBoundary failure
foundationReopenConditions.trigger: The frozen boundary repeatedly misclassifies ordinary direct rule execution as adjudication or repeatedly misses independently meaningful binding case statuses across materially different GameForms, and the error cannot be repaired by scope/currentness/authority/basis qualification.

foundationReopenConditions.name: Lineage/review failure
foundationReopenConditions.trigger: Repeated review/reversal/supersession cases require a non-derived semantic responsibility that cannot be reconstructed from determination events plus ordinary relation/time/authority/provenance history.

foundationReopenConditions.name: Determination-enforcement entanglement failure
foundationReopenConditions.trigger: At least two materially different GameForms require enforcement/remedy to be constitutive of determination identity in a way not representable through ordinary F4/GDF0/GDF1 transition relations while preserving Determination != Enforcement where counterfactually separable.

foundationReopenConditions.name: Role-fusion/substrate failure
foundationReopenConditions.trigger: Repeated Human/Agent/collective/solitary or role-fused cases require binding case semantics not expressible through existing entity/role/operation-specific authority/currentness relations, rather than merely a new implementation mechanism.

foundationReopenConditions.name: Ownership/generalization failure
foundationReopenConditions.trigger: At least two materially different downstream GameForms show that the frozen responsibility either belongs to a more general non-Game foundation or misses a Game-native case-status distinction that cannot be handed to World/Media/Human/Social/GeneralReasoning without explanatory loss.

foundationReopenConditions.name: Repeated downstream contradiction
foundationReopenConditions.trigger: At least two materially different downstream GameForms repeatedly falsify the same frozen ACD law rather than a derived view, local authority policy, representation choice or implementation mechanism.

postFreezeContinuation.requiredNextAction: Rerun whole-Game unexplored-space/domain-coverage search across GDF0-GDF3 and all previously preserved residuals; let the new residual/falsifier map determine whether a GDF4 is admitted and what it studies.
